scope.goal: Address independent-review findings for the documentation-only security-workflow pilot.

security_invariants.rule: Every implementation task must have a same-task Planner-to-Coder, Coder-to-Reviewer, and Reviewer-to-Planner handoff chain.
Record and release an exclusive coordination reservation before and after edits.
Record framework, source, and project freshness evidence without inventing verification dates.

authorization_expectations: No application, Firebase, dependency, cloud, deploy, FireFlow, tag, merge, or secret action is authorized.

positive: Validate the Planner-to-Coder and Coder-to-Reviewer JSON contracts against the framework schema.
Confirm all modified workflow files are listed in the Coder-to-Reviewer contract.
negative: Confirm no application or deployment file is changed.
Confirm a Reviewer remains independent of the Coder.

prohibited_actions: No application-code, configuration, Rules, Functions, or dependency change.
